headline: What’s the catch with the Apple Upgrade program?
summary: Apple's new Upgrade program offers device leasing. Lease iPhones, iPads, Macs, and Watches with low monthly payments. Total cost won't exceed full price over the 1-3 year term.

headline: OpenAI president says it’s ‘building a family of devices’ for its AI chatbots
summary: OpenAI president Greg Brockman confirms work on AI-powered devices. The company is developing a "family of devices" for chatbot interaction. Rumors of a smart speaker were not confirmed.

headline: The US government just banned Roombas
summary: US government has banned "advanced robotic devices." The ban extends to robot vacuum cleaners, like Roombas. FCC confirmed the ban covers more than just humanoid robots.

headline: Full school day cellphone bans are more popular than ever
summary: Support for school cellphone bans is at an all-time high. 77% of US adults back bans in middle and high school classes. Nearly half (48%) support full-day cellphone bans.

headline: Yaga's Noah Reid Says People Will See 'A Different Side' to Hudson Williams in the Upcoming Series
summary: Actor Noah Reid discusses his role in the upcoming series, Yaga. Reid promises a new perspective on the character Hudson Williams. Fans can expect to see a "different side" to Williams.

headline: Halo: Campaign Evolved Modders Have Already Added Iron Man, Carl Johnson From GTA, and More
summary: Halo: Campaign Evolved modders are introducing wild character swaps. Players can now play as Iron Man or GTA's Carl Johnson. Master Chief can be replaced by CJ from Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas.

headline: Save 20% off the LEGO Game Boy, Which Happens to be the First Ever Deal I've Seen for This Set
summary: The LEGO Game Boy set is currently 20% off. This marks the first reported deal for the popular set. A must-have for LEGO collectors and gamers alike.

headline: Xbox Promises to Investigate Reports of Service Outage Preventing Players From Accessing Physical Games
summary: Xbox experienced a service outage preventing access to physical games. Players reported physical discs requiring an internet connection to play. Xbox vows to investigate the outage and address digital ownership concerns.

headline: More than half of England in drought, Environment Agency declares
summary: Over half of England is officially declared to be in drought. The declaration follows a period of extreme heat and dryness. Rivers, crops, and natural environments are severely impacted.

headline: Burnham doesn't rule out tax rises to fix social care
summary: Burnham indicates openness to tax increases for social care funding. The Prime Minister is accelerating a review of England's social care system. Cross-party talks are underway to address the issue.

headline: Moment police officers set foot in 'horror scene' funeral home
summary: Police entered a Hull funeral home described as a 'horror scene'. Officers found messy side rooms cluttered with rubbish. The discovery was made at the Legacy funeral home.

headline: Four women accuse Jared Leto of criminal sexual conduct when they were teenagers
summary: Jared Leto faces new accusations of criminal sexual conduct. Four women allege mistreatment by Leto when they were teenagers. In total, ten women have come forward with similar allegations.
